notablePrerequisites: You control at least three mana-producing lands, plus three in any combination of additional mana-producing lands and/or legendary creatures.
description:
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing Orzhov Basilica, adding {B}.
Repeat step 1 for each remaining mana-producing land you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing World Shaper, adding {G}.
When World Shaper dies, its second ability triggers, causing you to return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Takenuma from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Takenuma's channel ability by paying at most {3}{B}, causing you to mill three cards and return World Shaper from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast World Shaper by paying {3}{G}.
Repeat.
If you control additional mana-producing lands beyond what is required, this combo nets infinite colored mana if one of those lands produces {B} or {G}, or infinite mana lands you control can produce otherwise.
